text:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — putting up a tiny design review for the model catalog compare table. Main things: chip ordering for filters, pinned-version affordance, and how granular the performance badges should be. Screenshot: <https://redwood.design/mockups/compare-2026-03-23.png>
Henry Wu: Love the mock. First question — should chips be ordered by recency or by selected priority? i.e., if user checks multiple facets, what wins?
Zoe Kim: My vote is 'selected priority' (user-chosen order), with an implicit fallback of frequency (most-used) when not explicitly reordered. We should surface a drag handle for advanced users.
Kara Gomez: Accessibility nit — if we add drag handles, ensure keyboard reorder is available (move left/right with ctrl+arrow) and aria-live announces new order.
Samir Rao: +1 on keyboard reorder. Also: when a user pins a model version from compare, do we pin per-row or globally for that model id across compare? Current mock pins per-row which felt odd.
Maya Patel: Good call. We discussed this earlier but didn't land. Proposal: pin should be per-model (global) if pinned from the top-level header on a model card; pin-per-row only if you pin from the compare row context. That keeps behavior predictable.
Henry Wu: That makes sense. Microcopy suggestion: change "Pin version" -> "Lock version for model" to clarify scope. Thoughts?
Zoe Kim: Shorter is better. Maybe "Lock version (model)" is confusing. I propose "Pin version — model-wide" in the tooltip only. Keep button label as "Pin".
Kara Gomez: Tooltip approach works. Also check contrast for the pin icon state (filled vs outline). I measured the filled state: 2.8:1 on a few backgrounds — needs to be >=3:1. Can we bump the filled color by ~10% luminance?
Samir Rao: I'll take a pass on colors. For performance badges: folks worried badges are too noisy when we show p50/p95/p99 separately. Could we collapse into a single badge with a mini-sparkline and show p95 on hover?
Maya Patel: Yes — consolidate by default to one badge labeled "perf" with a small summary metric (p95). Hover/expand shows the three percentiles and trend. Inline hover should be keyboard accessible (focus reveals details).
Henry Wu: Implementation detail — prefer a tooltip triggered by focus with role="dialog" inside a popover. Avoid hover-only patterns.
frontend-bot: FYI deploy-preview for the compact badge is at https://staging.redwood.io/compare/badge-compact
Zoe Kim: Copy tweak on the compact mode: current header reads "Compact" — request: change to "Compact view — denser rows" for first time tooltip messaging.
Maya Patel: Good. Also UX flow: when a user applies a multi-select filter and then pins a version, the filter chips should persist if they navigate away and come back within the same session. Is session persistence in scope?
Samir Rao: We have localStorage-backed filter state for most pages. I'll verify compare table includes it; if not, I'll add a migration ticket.
Kara Gomez: A11y checklist: focus order for compare rows, aria-sort for sortable columns, visible focus ring on row expansion, and keyboard escape to close any open badge popovers.
Henry Wu: One more edge: when collapsing rows in compact mode, ensure the pin control remains visually accessible (not hidden by overflow ellipsis). Suggest moving pin to the leftmost action area.
Maya Patel: Action items:
- Samir to confirm localStorage persistence + color contrast adjustments (owner: Samir, due: Thu)
- Henry to prototype keyboard reorder pattern and popover semantics (owner: Henry, due: Fri)
- Zoe to update microcopy and tooltip copy for compact mode and pin tooltip (owner: Zoe, due: Wed)
- Kara to run quick a11y pass after changes (owner: Kara, due: next Tue)
- Samir + Frontend to verify staging link and attach PR when ready (owner: Samir, frontend team, due: next Wed)
design-bot: Noted tasks and owners. Creating follow-up ticket in JIRA: RD-INF-4521
Maya Patel: Thanks all — will iterate on the mock with these changes and re-share. :thumbsup:
